props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DEF-GAP->BONUS]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

// Resolve attacker safely

const attackerActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.");

return;

}

// Resolve first target

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No target found. No bonus damage applied.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.");

return;

}

// Read DEF values

const userDef = Number(attackerActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

const targetDef = Number(targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

// Gate: only grant bonus if user DEF is higher

const defDifference = userDef - targetDef;

const bonusDamage = defDifference > 0 ? defDifference * 10 : 0;

// Apply bonus damage into advPayload

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const bonusBefore = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore + bonusDamage;

// Optional debug info

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.defGapBonusDebug = {

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? "",

target: targetActor?.name ?? "",

userDef,

targetDef,

defDifference,

bonusDamage

};

console.log(TAG, bonusDamage > 0 ? "APPLIED" : "NO BONUS", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

target: targetActor?.name,

userDef,

targetDef,

defDifference,

bonusBefore,

bonusAdded: bonusDamage,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});
props.description: This skill deals bonus damage equal to the 【difference between this creature DEF and the target x 10 】
props.name: Golem Punch
